sources.title: Greek Ministry of Interior, Structure and Operation of Local Government, 2024
inspected_facts: Municipalities and Regions are first and second level local government; 332 municipalities and 13 Regions are reported.
The Ministry describes Regions and municipalities as separate levels without hierarchical relationship/control.
The paper describes Mount Athos/Aghion Oros as a self-governed part of Greece.

sources.limit: Exact response checksum was not retained; this is a textual/current-structure source, not a municipal boundary geometry.
